verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ מִזְבֵּ֖חַ מִקְטַ֣ר קְטֹ֑רֶת עֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּ֖ים תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā miz·bê·aḥ miq·ṭar qə·ṭō·reṯ ‘ă·ṣê šiṭ·ṭîm ta·‘ă·śeh ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: You are also to make an altar - of acacia wood for the burning of incense
verses.literalPt: Farás também um altar para queimares sobre ele o incenso; de madeira de acácia o farás.

verses.original: אַמָּ֨ה אָרְכּ֜וֹ וְאַמָּ֤ה רָחְבּוֹ֙ רָב֣וּעַ יִהְיֶ֔ה וְאַמָּתַ֖יִם קֹמָת֑וֹ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ קַרְנֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ’am·māh ’ā·rə·kōw wə·’am·māh rā·ḥə·bōw rā·ḇū·a‘ yih·yeh wə·’am·mā·ṯa·yim qō·mā·ṯōw mim·men·nū qar·nō·ṯāw
verses.literal: It is to be square a cubit long a cubit wide and two cubits high Its horns must be of one piece
verses.literalPt: Terá um cúbito de comprido, e um cúbito de largo (será quadrado), e dois cúbitos de alto; os chifres formarão uma só peça com ele.

verses.original: וְצִפִּיתָ֨ אֹת֜וֹ זָהָ֣ב טָה֗וֹר אֶת־ גַּגּ֧וֹ וְאֶת־ קִירֹתָ֛יו סָבִ֖יב וְאֶת־ קַרְנֹתָ֑יו וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ לּ֛וֹ זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣip·pî·ṯā ’ō·ṯōw zā·hāḇ ṭā·hō·wr ’eṯ- gag·gōw wə·’eṯ- qî·rō·ṯāw sā·ḇîḇ wə·’eṯ- qar·nō·ṯāw wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā lōw zêr zā·hāḇ sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: Overlay with pure gold the top and all the sides and horns and make a molding of gold around it
verses.literalPt: Cobri-lo-ás de ouro puro, a sua parte superior, os seus lados ao redor e os seus chifres; e lhe farás uma bordadura de ouro.

verses.original: וּשְׁתֵּי֩ טַבְּעֹ֨ת זָהָ֜ב תַּֽעֲשֶׂה־ לּ֣וֹ׀ מִתַּ֣חַת לְזֵר֗וֹ עַ֚ל שְׁתֵּ֣י צַלְעֹתָ֔יו תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה עַל־ שְׁנֵ֣י צִדָּ֑יו וְהָיָה֙ לְבָתִּ֣ים לְבַדִּ֔ים לָשֵׂ֥את אֹת֖וֹ בָּהֵֽמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·tê ṭab·bə·‘ōṯ zā·hāḇ ta·‘ă·śeh- lōw mit·ta·ḥaṯ lə·zê·rōw ‘al šə·tê ṣal·‘ō·ṯāw ta·‘ă·śeh ‘al- šə·nê ṣid·dāw wə·hā·yāh lə·ḇāt·tîm lə·ḇad·dîm lā·śêṯ ’ō·ṯōw bā·hêm·māh
verses.literal: And make two gold rings below the molding - - on . . . opposite sides to hold the poles used to carry it
verses.literalPt: Também lhe farás duas argolas de ouro debaixo da bordadura; em ambos os lados, as farás; e nelas se meterão os varais para se levar o altar.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת־ הַבַּדִּ֖ים עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתָ֖ם זָהָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ’eṯ- hab·bad·dîm ‘ă·ṣê šiṭ·ṭîm wə·ṣip·pî·ṯā ’ō·ṯām zā·hāḇ
verses.literal: Make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold
verses.literalPt: De madeira de acácia farás os varais e os cobrirás de ouro.

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֤ה אֹתוֹ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הַפָּרֹ֔כֶת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ אֲרֹ֣ן הָעֵדֻ֑ת לִפְנֵ֣י הַכַּפֹּ֗רֶת אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־ הָ֣עֵדֻ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֛ר אִוָּעֵ֥ד לְךָ֖ שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tāh ’ō·ṯōw lip̄·nê hap·pā·rō·ḵeṯ ’ă·šer ‘al- ’ă·rōn hā·‘ê·ḏuṯ lip̄·nê hak·kap·pō·reṯ ’ă·šer ‘al- hā·‘ê·ḏuṯ ’ă·šer ’iw·wā·‘êḏ lə·ḵā šām·māh
verses.literal: Place the altar in front of the veil that is before the ark of the Testimony before the mercy seat that is over the Testimony where I will meet with you . . .
verses.literalPt: Porás o altar em frente do véu que está junto à arca do Testemunho, diante do propiciatório que se acha sobre o Testemunho, onde virei a ti.

verses.original: וְהִקְטִ֥יר עָלָ֛יו אַהֲרֹ֖ן קְטֹ֣רֶת סַמִּ֑ים בַּבֹּ֣קֶר בַּבֹּ֗קֶר בְּהֵיטִיב֛וֹ אֶת־ הַנֵּרֹ֖ת יַקְטִירֶֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·ṭîr ‘ā·lāw ’a·hă·rōn qə·ṭō·reṯ sam·mîm bab·bō·qer bab·bō·qer bə·hê·ṭî·ḇōw ’eṯ- han·nê·rōṯ yaq·ṭî·ren·nāh
verses.literal: And Aaron is to burn fragrant incense on it every morning . . . when he tends the lamps
verses.literalPt: Arão queimará sobre o altar incenso aromático; todos os dias de manhã, quando preparar as lâmpadas, o queimará.

verses.original: וּבְהַעֲלֹ֨ת אַהֲרֹ֧ן אֶת־ הַנֵּרֹ֛ת בֵּ֥ין הָעֲרְבַּ֖יִם יַקְטִירֶ֑נָּה קְטֹ֧רֶת תָּמִ֛יד לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ha·‘ă·lōṯ ’a·hă·rōn ’eṯ- han·nê·rōṯ bên hā·‘ăr·ba·yim yaq·ṭî·ren·nāh qə·ṭō·reṯ tā·mîḏ lip̄·nê Yah·weh lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: When Aaron sets up the lamps at twilight he must burn the incense perpetually before the LORD for the generations to come
verses.literalPt: Quando, à tarde, acender as lâmpadas, o queimará; será incenso perpétuo diante de Jeová, pelas vossas gerações.

verses.original: לֹא־ תַעֲל֥וּ עָלָ֛יו קְטֹ֥רֶת זָרָ֖ה וְעֹלָ֣ה וּמִנְחָ֑ה וְנֵ֕סֶךְ לֹ֥א תִסְּכ֖וּ עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯa·‘ă·lū ‘ā·lāw qə·ṭō·reṯ zā·rāh wə·‘ō·lāh ū·min·ḥāh wə·nê·seḵ lō ṯis·sə·ḵū ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: On this altar you must not offer unauthorized incense or a burnt offering or grain offering nor are you to pour a drink offering on it
verses.literalPt: Não oferecereis sobre ele incenso estranho, nem holocaustos, nem oferta de flor de farinha; e não derramareis sobre ele ofertas de libação.

verses.original: וְכִפֶּ֤ר אַהֲרֹן֙ עַל־ קַרְנֹתָ֔יו אַחַ֖ת בַּשָּׁנָ֑ה מִדַּ֞ם חַטַּ֣את הַכִּפֻּרִ֗ים אַחַ֤ת בַּשָּׁנָה֙ יְכַפֵּ֤ר עָלָיו֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם קֹֽדֶשׁ־ קָֽדָשִׁ֥ים ה֖וּא לַיהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵip·per ’a·hă·rōn ‘al- qar·nō·ṯāw ’a·ḥaṯ baš·šā·nāh mid·dam ḥaṭ·ṭaṯ hak·kip·pu·rîm ’a·ḥaṯ baš·šā·nāh yə·ḵap·pêr ‘ā·lāw lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem qō·ḏeš- qā·ḏā·šîm hū Yah·weh
verses.literal: Once a year Aaron shall make atonement on the horns of the altar Throughout your generations he shall make atonement on it annually . . . with the blood of the sin offering of atonement The altar is most holy to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Uma vez no ano, Arão fará expiação sobre os chifres do altar; com o sangue da oferta pelo pecado, que é oferecido pela expiação, uma vez no ano, pelas vossas gerações, fará pelo altar expiação; santíssimo é a Jeová.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse mais Jeová a Moisés:

verses.original: כִּ֣י תִשָּׂ֞א אֶת־ רֹ֥אשׁ בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם֒ וְנָ֨תְנ֜וּ אִ֣ישׁ כֹּ֧פֶר נַפְשׁ֛וֹ לַיהוָ֖ה בִּפְקֹ֣ד אֹתָ֑ם וְלֹא־ יִהְיֶ֥ה בָהֶ֛ם נֶ֖גֶף בִּפְקֹ֥ד אֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî ṯiś·śā ’eṯ- rōš bə·nê- yiś·rå̄·ʾēl lip̄·qu·ḏê·hem wə·nā·ṯə·nū ’îš kō·p̄er nap̄·šōw Yah·weh bip̄·qōḏ ’ō·ṯām wə·lō- yih·yeh ḇā·hem ne·ḡep̄ bip̄·qōḏ ’ō·ṯām
verses.literal: When you take a census - of the Israelites to number them each man must pay the LORD a ransom for his life when he is counted Then no plague will come upon them when they are numbered
verses.literalPt: Quando fizeres o alistamento dos filhos de Israel, de acordo com o número desse alistamento, cada um deles dará a Jeová o resgate de sua alma, quando os alistares, para que não haja entre eles praga alguma por ocasião do alistamento.

verses.original: זֶ֣ה׀ יִתְּנ֗וּ כָּל־ הָעֹבֵר֙ עַל־ הַפְּקֻדִ֔ים מַחֲצִ֥ית הַשֶּׁ֖קֶל בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִ֤ים גֵּרָה֙ הַשֶּׁ֔קֶל מַחֲצִ֣ית הַשֶּׁ֔קֶל תְּרוּמָ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: zeh yit·tə·nū kāl- hā·‘ō·ḇêr ‘al- hap·pə·qu·ḏîm ma·ḥă·ṣîṯ haš·še·qel bə·še·qel haq·qō·ḏeš ‘eś·rîm gê·rāh haš·še·qel ma·ḥă·ṣîṯ haš·še·qel tə·rū·māh Yah·weh
verses.literal: Everyone who crosses over to those counted must pay a half shekel according to the sanctuary shekel which weighs twenty gerahs This half shekel is an offering to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Isto darão (cada um que passa para o número daqueles que são alistados): meio siclo segundo o siclo do santuário (o siclo tem vinte óbolos); oferecer-se-á a Jeová meio siclo.

verses.original: כֹּ֗ל הָעֹבֵר֙ עַל־ הַפְּקֻדִ֔ים מִבֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וָמָ֑עְלָה יִתֵּ֖ן תְּרוּמַ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kōl hā·‘ō·ḇêr ‘al- hap·pə·qu·ḏîm mib·ben ‘eś·rîm šā·nāh wā·mā·‘ə·lāh yit·tên tə·rū·maṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Everyone twenty years of age . . . or older who crosses over must give this offering to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Todo aquele que passa para o número dos que são alistados de vinte anos para cima pagará a oferta de Jeová.

verses.original: הֶֽעָשִׁ֣יר לֹֽא־ יַרְבֶּ֗ה וְהַדַּל֙ לֹ֣א יַמְעִ֔יט מִֽמַּחֲצִ֖ית הַשָּׁ֑קֶל לָתֵת֙ אֶת־ תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה לְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל־ נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: he·‘ā·šîr lō- yar·beh wə·had·dal lō yam·‘îṭ mim·ma·ḥă·ṣîṯ haš·šā·qel lā·ṯêṯ ’eṯ- tə·rū·maṯ Yah·weh lə·ḵap·pêr ‘al- nap̄·šō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: In making the offering to the LORD to atone for your lives the rich shall not give more than a half shekel nor shall the poor give less
verses.literalPt: O rico não dará mais, nem o pobre dará menos do que o meio siclo, quando derem a oferta de Jeová, para fazerdes expiação pelas vossas almas.

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֞ אֶת־ כֶּ֣סֶף הַכִּפֻּרִ֗ים מֵאֵת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְנָתַתָּ֣ אֹת֔וֹ עַל־ עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְהָיָה֩ לִבְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל לְזִכָּרוֹן֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל־ נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ·tā ’eṯ- ke·sep̄ hak·kip·pu·rîm mê·’êṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·nā·ṯa·tā ’ō·ṯōw ‘al- ‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ wə·hā·yāh liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl lə·zik·kā·rō·wn lip̄·nê Yah·weh lə·ḵap·pêr ‘al- nap̄·šō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: Take the atonement . . . money from the Israelites . . . and use it for the service of the Tent of Meeting It will serve as a memorial for the Israelites . . . before the LORD to make atonement for your lives
verses.literalPt: Dos filhos de Israel tomarás o dinheiro da expiação e designá-lo-ás para o serviço da tenda da revelação, para que sirva de memorial a favor dos filhos de Israel, diante de Jeová, a fim de fazerdes expiação pelas vossas almas.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Moses
verses.literalPt: Disse mais Jeová a Moisés:

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֜יתָ כִּיּ֥וֹר נְחֹ֛שֶׁת וְכַנּ֥וֹ נְחֹ֖שֶׁת לְרָחְצָ֑ה וְנָתַתָּ֣ אֹת֗וֹ בֵּֽין־ אֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ וּבֵ֣ין הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְנָתַתָּ֥ שָׁ֖מָּה מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā kî·yō·wr nə·ḥō·šeṯ wə·ḵan·nōw nə·ḥō·šeṯ lə·rā·ḥə·ṣāh wə·nā·ṯa·tā ’ō·ṯōw bên- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ ū·ḇên ham·miz·bê·aḥ wə·nā·ṯa·tā šām·māh mā·yim
verses.literal: You are to make a bronze basin with a bronze stand for washing Set it between the Tent of Meeting . . . and the altar and put water in it
verses.literalPt: Farás uma bacia de cobre e a sua base de cobre, para lavatório. Colocá-la-ás entre a tenda da revelação e o altar e nela deitarás água.

verses.original: וְרָחֲצ֛וּ אַהֲרֹ֥ן וּבָנָ֖יו מִמֶּ֑נּוּ אֶת־ יְדֵיהֶ֖ם וְאֶת־ רַגְלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·ḥă·ṣū ’a·hă·rōn ū·ḇā·nāw mim·men·nū ’eṯ- yə·ḏê·hem wə·’eṯ- raḡ·lê·hem
verses.literal: with which Aaron and his sons are to wash their hands and feet
verses.literalPt: Junto a ela, Arão e seus filhos lavarão as mãos e os pés;

verses.original: בְּבֹאָ֞ם אֶל־ אֹ֧הֶל מוֹעֵ֛ד יִרְחֲצוּ־ מַ֖יִם וְלֹ֣א יָמֻ֑תוּ א֣וֹ בְגִשְׁתָּ֤ם אֶל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ לְשָׁרֵ֔ת לְהַקְטִ֥יר אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḇō·’ām ’el- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ yir·ḥă·ṣū- ma·yim wə·lō yā·mu·ṯū ’ōw ḇə·ḡiš·tām ’el- ham·miz·bê·aḥ lə·šā·rêṯ lə·haq·ṭîr ’iš·šeh Yah·weh
verses.literal: Whenever they enter . . . the Tent of Meeting or approach . . . the altar to minister by presenting a food offering to the LORD they must wash with water so that they will not die
verses.literalPt: quando entrarem na tenda da revelação, lavar-se-ão com água, para que não morram; ou quando se chegarem ao altar para ministrar, para fazer uma oferta queimada a Jeová.

verses.original: וְרָחֲצ֛וּ יְדֵיהֶ֥ם וְרַגְלֵיהֶ֖ם וְלֹ֣א יָמֻ֑תוּ וְהָיְתָ֨ה לָהֶ֧ם חָק־ עוֹלָ֛ם ל֥וֹ וּלְזַרְע֖וֹ לְדֹרֹתָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·ḥă·ṣū yə·ḏê·hem wə·raḡ·lê·hem wə·lō yā·mu·ṯū wə·hā·yə·ṯāh lā·hem ḥāq- ‘ō·w·lām lōw ū·lə·zar·‘ōw lə·ḏō·rō·ṯām
verses.literal: Thus they are to wash their hands and feet so that they will not die this shall be a permanent statute for Aaron and his descendants for the generations to come
verses.literalPt: Lavarão as mãos e os pés, para que não morram; isso lhes será por estatuto perpétuo, a ele e à sua posteridade.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse mais Jeová a Moisés:

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה קַח־ לְךָ֮ בְּשָׂמִ֣ים רֹאשׁ֒ מָר־ דְּרוֹר֙ חֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת וְקִנְּמָן־ בֶּ֥שֶׂם מַחֲצִית֖וֹ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּמָאתָ֑יִם וּקְנֵה־ בֹ֖שֶׂם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּמָאתָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh qaḥ- lə·ḵā bə·śā·mîm rōš mār- də·rō·wr ḥă·mêš mê·’ō·wṯ wə·qin·nə·mān- be·śem ma·ḥă·ṣî·ṯōw ḥă·miš·šîm ū·mā·ṯā·yim ū·qə·nêh- ḇō·śem ḥă·miš·šîm ū·mā·ṯā·yim
verses.literal: Take the finest spices 500 shekels . . . of liquid myrrh half that amount (250 shekels) . . . of fragrant cinnamon 250 shekels . . . of fragrant cane
verses.literalPt: Toma as principais especiarias: de mirra pura, quinhentos siclos; de cinamomo aromático, a metade, isto é, duzentos e cinquenta siclos; de cálamo aromático, duzentos e cinquenta siclos;

verses.original: וְקִדָּ֕ה חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וְשֶׁ֥מֶן זַ֖יִת הִֽין׃
verses.transliteration: wə·qid·dāh ḥă·mêš mê·’ō·wṯ bə·še·qel haq·qō·ḏeš wə·še·men za·yiṯ hîn
verses.literal: 500 shekels . . . of cassia all according to the sanctuary shekel and a hin of olive oil
verses.literalPt: e de cássia, quinhentos siclos, segundo o siclo do santuário; e de azeite de oliveira, a medida de um him.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ אֹת֗וֹ שֶׁ֚מֶן מִשְׁחַת־ קֹ֔דֶשׁ רֹ֥קַח מִרְקַ֖חַת מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה רֹקֵ֑חַ שֶׁ֥מֶן מִשְׁחַת־ קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ’ō·ṯōw še·men miš·ḥaṯ- qō·ḏeš rō·qaḥ mir·qa·ḥaṯ ma·‘ă·śêh rō·qê·aḥ še·men miš·ḥaṯ- qō·ḏeš yih·yeh
verses.literal: Prepare from these a sacred anointing oil a fragrant blend . . . the work of a perfumer it will be a sacred anointing oil
verses.literalPt: Farás um óleo sagrado para as unções, um perfume composto segundo a arte do perfumista; será um óleo sagrado para as unções.

verses.original: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֥ ב֖וֹ אֶת־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְאֵ֖ת אֲר֥וֹן הָעֵדֻֽת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mā·šaḥ·tā ḇōw ’eṯ- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ wə·’êṯ ’ă·rō·wn hā·‘ê·ḏuṯ
verses.literal: Use this oil to anoint the Tent of Meeting the ark of the Testimony
verses.literalPt: Ungirás com ele a tenda da revelação, e a arca do Testemunho,

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלָ֔יו וְאֶת־ הַמְּנֹרָ֖ה וְאֶת־ כֵּלֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֖ת מִזְבַּ֥ח הַקְּטֹֽרֶת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- haš·šul·ḥān wə·’eṯ- kāl- kê·lāw wə·’eṯ- ham·mə·nō·rāh wə·’eṯ- kê·le·hā wə·’êṯ miz·baḥ haq·qə·ṭō·reṯ
verses.literal: the table and all its utensils the lampstand and its utensils the altar of incense
verses.literalPt: e a mesa com todos os seus utensílios e o candeeiro com os seus utensílios, e o altar de incenso,

verses.original: וְאֶת־ מִזְבַּ֥ח הָעֹלָ֖ה וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלָ֑יו וְאֶת־ הַכִּיֹּ֖ר וְאֶת־ כַּנּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- miz·baḥ hā·‘ō·lāh wə·’eṯ- kāl- kê·lāw wə·’eṯ- hak·kî·yōr wə·’eṯ- kan·nōw
verses.literal: the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils and the basin with its stand
verses.literalPt: e o altar dos holocaustos com todos os seus utensílios e a bacia com a sua base.

verses.original: וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֣ אֹתָ֔ם וְהָי֖וּ קֹ֣דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֑ים כָּל־ הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּהֶ֖ם יִקְדָּֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·qid·daš·tā ’ō·ṯām wə·hā·yū qō·ḏeš qā·ḏā·šîm kāl- han·nō·ḡê·a‘ bā·hem yiq·dāš
verses.literal: You are to consecrate them so that they will be most holy Whatever touches them shall be holy
verses.literalPt: Santificarás essas coisas, para que sejam santíssimas; aquele que as tocar será santificado.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ אַהֲרֹ֥ן וְאֶת־ בָּנָ֖יו תִּמְשָׁ֑ח וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם לְכַהֵ֥ן לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ’a·hă·rōn wə·’eṯ- bā·nāw tim·šāḥ wə·qid·daš·tā ’ō·ṯām lə·ḵa·hên lî
verses.literal: Anoint Aaron and his sons and consecrate them to serve Me as priests
verses.literalPt: Ungirás a Arão e a seus filhos e os santificarás, para que me sirvam no ofício sacerdotal.

verses.original: וְאֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תְּדַבֵּ֣ר לֵאמֹ֑ר שֶׁ֠מֶן מִשְׁחַת־ קֹ֨דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֥ה זֶ֛ה לִ֖י לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl tə·ḏab·bêr lê·mōr še·men miš·ḥaṯ- qō·ḏeš yih·yeh zeh lî lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: And you are to tell . . . . . . the Israelites . . . This will be My sacred anointing oil for the generations to come
verses.literalPt: Dirás aos filhos de Israel: Este me será o óleo sagrado para as unções, por toda a vossa posteridade.

verses.original: עַל־ בְּשַׂ֤ר אָדָם֙ לֹ֣א יִיסָ֔ךְ וּבְמַ֨תְכֻּנְתּ֔וֹ לֹ֥א תַעֲשׂ֖וּ כָּמֹ֑הוּ קֹ֣דֶשׁ ה֔וּא קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- bə·śar ’ā·ḏām lō yî·sāḵ ū·ḇə·maṯ·kun·tōw lō ṯa·‘ă·śū kā·mō·hū qō·ḏeš hū qō·ḏeš yih·yeh lā·ḵem
verses.literal: It must not be used to anoint . . . an ordinary man . . . and you must not make anything like it with the same formula It is holy and it must be holy to you
verses.literalPt: Não se ungirá com ele a carne do homem, nem fareis outro semelhante, da mesma composição; é sagrado e será sagrado para vós.

verses.original: אִ֚ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִרְקַ֣ח כָּמֹ֔הוּ וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר יִתֵּ֛ן מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עַל־ זָ֑ר וְנִכְרַ֖ת מֵעַמָּֽיו׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’îš ’ă·šer yir·qaḥ kā·mō·hū wa·’ă·šer yit·tên mim·men·nū ‘al- zār wə·niḵ·raṯ mê·‘am·māw
verses.literal: Anyone who mixes perfume like it or puts it on an outsider shall be cut off from his people
verses.literalPt: Qualquer homem que fizer outro semelhante ou ungir com ele a um estrangeiro será exterminado do meio do seu povo.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֜ה קַח־ לְךָ֣ סַמִּ֗ים נָטָ֤ף׀ וּשְׁחֵ֙לֶת֙ וְחֶלְבְּנָ֔ה סַמִּ֖ים וּלְבֹנָ֣ה זַכָּ֑ה בַּ֥ד בְּבַ֖ד יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh qaḥ- lə·ḵā sam·mîm nā·ṭāp̄ ū·šə·ḥê·leṯ wə·ḥel·bə·nāh sam·mîm ū·lə·ḇō·nāh zak·kāh baḏ bə·ḇaḏ yih·yeh
verses.literal: The LORD also said to Moses Take fragrant spices gum resin onycha galbanum and pure frankincense in equal measures . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse mais Jeová a Moisés: Toma especiarias aromáticas: estoraque, ônica e gálbano, especiarias aromáticas com incenso puro. Cada uma delas será de igual peso;

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ אֹתָהּ֙ קְטֹ֔רֶת רֹ֖קַח מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה רוֹקֵ֑חַ מְמֻלָּ֖ח טָה֥וֹר קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ’ō·ṯāh qə·ṭō·reṯ rō·qaḥ ma·‘ă·śêh rō·w·qê·aḥ mə·mul·lāḥ ṭā·hō·wr qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: and make a fragrant blend of incense the work of a perfumer seasoned with salt pure and holy
verses.literalPt: e delas farás um incenso, um perfume segundo a arte do perfumista, temperado com sal, puro e santo.

verses.original: וְשָֽׁחַקְתָּ֣ מִמֶּנָּה֮ הָדֵק֒ וְנָתַתָּ֨ה מִמֶּ֜נָּה לִפְנֵ֤י הָעֵדֻת֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֛ר אִוָּעֵ֥ד לְךָ֖ שָׁ֑מָּה קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים תִּהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·ḥaq·tā mim·men·nāh hā·ḏêq wə·nā·ṯat·tāh mim·men·nāh lip̄·nê hā·‘ê·ḏuṯ bə·’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ ’ă·šer ’iw·wā·‘êḏ lə·ḵā šām·māh qō·ḏeš qā·ḏā·šîm tih·yeh lā·ḵem
verses.literal: Grind some of it into fine powder and place it in front of the Testimony in the Tent of Meeting where I will meet with you . . . It shall be most holy to you
verses.literalPt: Uma parte dele reduzirás a pó e o porás diante do Testemunho, na tenda da revelação, onde virei a ti; será para vós santíssimo.

verses.original: וְהַקְּטֹ֙רֶת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה בְּמַ֨תְכֻּנְתָּ֔הּ לֹ֥א תַעֲשׂ֖וּ לָכֶ֑ם קֹ֛דֶשׁ תִּהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֖ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·haq·qə·ṭō·reṯ ’ă·šer ta·‘ă·śeh bə·maṯ·kun·tāh lō ṯa·‘ă·śū lā·ḵem qō·ḏeš tih·yeh lə·ḵā Yah·weh
verses.literal: You are never to use . . . this formula to make incense for yourselves you shall regard it as holy . . . to the LORD
verses.literalPt: O incenso que fareis, segundo a composição deste, não o fareis para vós mesmos; considerá-lo-eis sagrado a Jeová.

verses.original: אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה כָמ֖וֹהָ לְהָרִ֣יחַ בָּ֑הּ וְנִכְרַ֖ת מֵעַמָּֽיו׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’îš ’ă·šer- ya·‘ă·śeh ḵā·mō·w·hā lə·hā·rî·aḥ bāh wə·niḵ·raṯ mê·‘am·māw
verses.literal: Anyone who makes something like it to enjoy its fragrance shall be cut off from his people
verses.literalPt: O homem que fizer tal como este para o cheirar será exterminado do meio do seu povo.
